summary: The list of blog articles (system section of the blog page). Close the page with the store-wide subscription as about half the stores do.
evidence: empty settings in about 4 in 5 stores
rules: Write `title`: with empty settings the storefront prints no heading at all, and the page's H1 goes to the next titled section (often the subscription).
A blog of 2-3 articles reads as empty in a grid of 4: `grid.columns` 3 with a big first row.
`grid.enableTwoColumnsOnTouch: true` (the default) cuts article titles on phones: write `false`.

presets.name: blog-small
presets.use: The blog page of a young blog (2-9 articles): a heading, 3 columns with a big first row, one article per phone row.
presets.evidence: empty settings in about 4 in 5 stores of the sample; the missing heading and the cut titles were seen on the storefront with those empty settings
presets.basis: the storefront prints no heading for empty settings and cuts titles at two per phone row
